Tryndamere.title: Raging Tryndamere
Tryndamere.description: Hark, brave barbarian! Thy friends call thee a grumpy grandfather of the realm, forever shaking a fist at the clouds. Passion burns in thy chest like a forge, and on the battlefield thou fearest nothing, not even death itself. Yet when plans go awry, thy fervor curdles into thunderous rage, and the tavern shall hear of it. Thou art loyal, stubborn, and impossible to put down, for thou simply refuseth to die until thou hast finished complaining.
Tryndamere.friend: Thou keepest few friends, but those few would march into dragonfire for thee. Thy loyalty is legendary, though thy temper is its equal. Companions learn to nod politely when thou ranteth about the proper way to hold an axe, and to hide the good ale when thou art in a mood. Thou shewest love through gruff gestures: a hearty shoulder-clap, a grudging 'well fought,' and fiercely defending them from any who dare mock thy fellowship at the long table.
Tryndamere.romance: Thy heart, once given, is given wholly, and with the subtlety of a battering ram. Thy beloved shall know passion most fierce, fiery quarrels, and even fierier reconciliations. Thou art protective to a fault and perhaps a touch self-centered, forgetting that thy partner hath opinions too. But thou wouldst slay armies for them without a moment's pause. Wooing thee requireth patience, a thick skin, and the wisdom never to say 'calm down' during an argument.
Tryndamere.games: Thy spirit craveth games of glorious carnage and unyielding defiance. Embark upon Dark Souls, where thou mayst die gloriously a hundred times and still return in fury. Try Hades, wherein rage is rewarded and escape is forever denied. Doom Eternal shall suit thy temperament, for it asketh only that thou rip and tear without pause. Should thy blood run too hot, Vampire Survivors lets thee slaughter whole hordes while grumbling contentedly in thy chair.

Amumu.title: Sad Amumu
Amumu.description: Alas, gentle soul swathed in bandages! Thou carriest a heart so tender it aches at the slightest sigh of the wind. Thou art lonely, yes, but also sweet, earnest, and prone to crying at things most would not even notice, such as a particularly noble sunset. In truth, thy sorrow is merely love with nowhere to go. Beware: when thy tears flow, all nearby shall weep along with thee, so keep a handkerchief and a hearty supply of cheer.
Amumu.friend: Thou desirest friendship above all treasures, and dost hold it as dear as gold. When thou findest a companion, thou clingest with the warmth of a lost puppy, which may startle the wary. Thou art the friend who rememberest birthdays, sendest sweet notes, and weepest openly at partings. Be mindful, dear one, not to smother thy fellows with affection, though they shall surely forgive thee, for who could stay cross at a creature so earnestly delighted by their very presence?
Amumu.romance: Thou art a hopeless romantic of the highest order, penning sonnets in thy mind and weeping at every tender glance. Thou fallest swiftly and fearfully, ever dreading that thy beloved shall depart. Yet thy devotion is pure as spring water, and thy partner shall never doubt being cherished. Thou needest only reassurance, gentle words, and an occasional hug to still thy trembling heart. In return, thou givest a love so soft it could mend the mightiest of kingdoms.
Amumu.games: Soft-hearted traveler, seek tales that cradle the weeping heart. Journey through Spiritfarer, where thou ferriest lost souls with kindness and tears aplenty. Try Stardew Valley, wherein every villager becometh a dear friend. Ori and the Blind Forest shall wring thy eyes dry within the first hour, and Animal Crossing offereth a cozy burrow where none shall ever be cruel to thee. Bring tissues and a warm blanket, noble mummy. Mind the sad songs, for they are ambushes.

Teemo.title: Devious Teemo
Teemo.description: Behold the cheerful scout with a smile most sinister! Thou speakest of honor and duty, yet thy pockets rattle with mushrooms of ill intent. Thou art charming, relentlessly upbeat, and utterly shameless in mischief, for thou truly believest thy pranks to be acts of public service. Folk across the realm have sworn vengeance upon thee, which only maketh thee wave more cheerfully. Thou art a menace in a tiny hat, and an absolute delight at parties.
Teemo.friend: Thy friends adore thee and fear thee in equal measure, for no feast is safe from a well-placed whoopee cushion. Thou art loyal, endlessly encouraging, and first to arrive with snacks, though one must inspect said snacks first. Thou rememberest every secret and revealeth none, save in jest. Be warned, good scout: trust is a fragile thing, and even thy dearest fellows have begun to check their boots before putting them on each morning.
Teemo.romance: Thy courtship is a grand campaign of small, charming ambushes: love letters hidden in unexpected places, flowers left at dawn, and the occasional harmless trap of affection. Thou art sweet, devoted, and perhaps too fond of surprises. Thy beloved shall never be bored, though they may startle at every closed cupboard. Wooing thee requireth a sense of humor, quick reflexes, and the grace to laugh when thou hast, once again, filled their shoes with confetti.
Teemo.games: Mischief-maker, thy joy lieth in clever traps and chaotic fun. Play Among Us and sow doubt with a cheerful grin, or Fall Guys for pure slapstick glory. Overcooked shall let thee sabotage thy friends under the guise of teamwork. Pummel Party is a masterwork of treachery, built for thy exact talents. And Mario Party shall test whether thy friendships can survive thy methods. Spoiler: they shall, barely. Mushrooms optional, though strongly encouraged. Scouts' honor, and no peeking.

Lux.title: Radiant Lux
Lux.description: Hail, bright maiden of dazzling light! Thou art the sunrise in human form: warm, optimistic, and mildly blinding at close range. Thou believest the best of everyone, which is either thy greatest strength or a charming flaw. Thou carriest thy secrets with grace, though thy giggles occasionally betray them. Folk gather round thee like moths to a lantern, and thou welcomest all with a beaming smile. Pray, do remember that not every shadow requireth a laser.
Lux.friend: Thou art the glowing heart of every gathering, the friend who organizeth the picnics, remembereth every name, and cheereth loudest at every triumph. Thy companions know thou wilt always answer their letters and light their darkest hours, quite literally. Thou mayst be overly optimistic at times, insisting a dragon is merely misunderstood, but thy faith in them lifteth their spirits. Thou art the kind of friend whom kingdoms are built to deserve.
Lux.romance: Thy love is a bright, sparkling thing, full of grand gestures, dazzling smiles, and well-meaning enthusiasm. Thou fallest in love with the best in a person and cheerfully ignorest the red flags waving nearby. Thy beloved shall feel adored beyond measure, though perhaps slightly overwhelmed by thy energy. Seek a partner who can match thy sparkle, and who shall gently inform thee when thou hast been blinding the entire room for the past hour.
Lux.games: Radiant one, thou thrivest in worlds of wonder and hopeful adventure. Play Genshin Impact for its sweeping vistas and magical flair, or Kirby and the Forgotten Land for pure joy. Sky: Children of the Light is a gentle dance of cooperation beneath glowing skies. Hi-Fi Rush shall suit thy rhythm and cheer. And Little Nightmares... nay, avoid it, for it shall extinguish thy light most cruelly. Choose kindness, dear lady.

Garen.title: Valiant Garen
Garen.description: Hail, stalwart knight, pride of the realm! Thou art honest to a fault, loud about thy virtues, and utterly convinced that most problems may be solved by a firm handshake or a spin. Thou lovest rules, rank, and a well-polished breastplate. Thy sincerity is genuinely endearing, though subtlety hath never once been invited to thy feasts. Thou wouldst never lie, never cheat, and never understand why thy comrades hide when thou beginnest a speech about honor.
Garen.friend: Thou art the dependable shield-brother every adventuring party needeth. Thou standest first in line, carriest the heavy packs, and offerest advice whether solicited or not. Thy loyalty is unwavering, and thy sense of justice shall cause the occasional quarrel with more flexible folk. Thy friends lovingly tease thee for thy speeches, yet each knoweth that, in the dark hour, it is thy voice that shall rally them. Thou art a rock, and quite proud of it.
Garen.romance: Thou courtest as thou fightest: directly, sincerely, and with great fanfare. Expect formal declarations, sturdy gifts, and promises of lifelong devotion made on the very first evening. Thy beloved shall always be defended and respected, though perhaps not always understood when thou spendest date night polishing thy sword. Seek a partner who appreciateth steadfast devotion, tolerateth thy rigid schedule, and can gently remind thee that spontaneity is not, in fact, a crime.
Garen.games: Noble knight, thou preferest games of honor, order, and well-earned victory. Embark upon Baldur's Gate 3 as a righteous paladin, or Mount & Blade for glorious cavalry charges. Total War shall indulge thy love of grand formations. For Honor lets thee duel with dignity, and Fire Emblem offereth tactics, loyalty, and tragically honorable speeches. Do take care in Diplomacy, however, as thou shalt lose all friends for the sake of principle.

Ahri.title: Charming Ahri
Ahri.description: Behold the nine-tailed enchantress, sly and radiant! Thou art effortlessly magnetic, with a smile that hath ended many sensible plans. Thou lovest beauty, mischief, and the thrill of a clever game, though beneath thy teasing lieth a restless curiosity about who thou truly art. Folk adore thee on sight, which thou findest both flattering and slightly tiresome. Thou art playful, perceptive, and dangerously good at getting thy way, always with a wink and a flourish.
Ahri.friend: Thy circle is small, glittering, and loyal, for thou chooseth thy companions with a fox's keen instinct. Thou art the friend who draggeth everyone to the festival, plucketh the gossip from the air, and soothest a bruised heart with wine and a sharp-tongued joke. Thou art generous with thy charm, though thou guardest thy true feelings closely. Those who earn thy trust discover a friend as warm as a hearth and twice as bright.
Ahri.romance: Love is thy favorite game, and thou playest it beautifully. Thou flirtest with ease, charmest with a glance, and leavest many a heart fluttering in thy wake. Yet beneath the flourish thou secretly yearnest for someone who seeth past the glamour. When thou findest such a soul, thy devotion runneth deep and true. Until then, expect dazzling courtships, a few broken hearts, and one very tragic poem composed by a spurned bard.
Ahri.games: Enchantress, thou delightest in beautiful worlds and cunning charm. Play Persona 5 for style, stolen hearts, and sharp dialogue, or Ghost of Tsushima for sweeping scenery. Genshin Impact suits thy flair, while Dream Daddy offereth splendid romance. Cult of the Lamb allows thee to charm entire congregations. Do be wary of Among Us, for thou shalt be accused first, and wrongfully, and with great drama. Pour thyself some tea, and enjoy the show.

Yasuo.title: Wandering Yasuo
Yasuo.description: Ho there, lone wanderer of the winds! Thou art a drifter with a tragic past, a sharp blade, and a firm conviction that nothing is thy fault, save for the parts that are. Thou speakest in riddles, drinkest in taverns, and lovest the open road more than any hearth. Folk say thou art brooding, but really thou art simply dramatic. Thou fightest best when the wind is at thy back and all thy allies have wandered off in confusion.
Yasuo.friend: Thou makest friends easily and loseth them just as breezily, drifting from village to village like a leaf on the gale. Those who stay find thee loyal, wise in odd ways, and prone to disappearing mid-conversation to stare meaningfully at horizons. Thou art the friend who showeth up at dawn with a story and a bottle, then vanisheth by noon. Thy companions have learned to treasure the moments, and to never ask where thou wentest.
Yasuo.romance: Thy love is a storm: sudden, passionate, and gone before breakfast. Thou art charming in a wistful, windswept way, and many a heart hath fallen for thy mysterious sighs. But thou fearest to be tied down, and thy partner may wake to find thee gone, leaving only a cryptic poem. Seek one who shall walk the road beside thee, understand thy silences, and politely refrain from asking about thy brother.
Yasuo.games: Wanderer, thou seekest stories of lonely journeys and swift blades. Play Ghost of Tsushima, where the wind itself guideth thy path, or Sekiro for duels most unforgiving. Red Dead Redemption 2 shall satisfy thy love of the open road and tragic regrets. Hollow Knight offereth quiet melancholy and elegant combat. And if thou wishest for a laugh, Mount & Blade lets thee wander about and ruin a kingdom with great style.

Jinx.title: Chaotic Jinx
Jinx.description: Well met, gleeful agent of mayhem! Thou art a whirlwind of laughter, explosives, and unpredictable mood swings, wrapped in blue braids and bad ideas. Thou dost nothing by halves: when thou art happy, the whole town shall know, and when thou art cross, so shall the whole town's windows. Underneath thy cackle lieth a tender, wounded heart, though thou wouldst deny it with a grin and a rocket. Thou art delightful, terrifying, and entirely impossible to schedule.
Jinx.friend: Thou art a delight to the few who can keep pace, showering them with gifts that may or may not explode. Thou art fiercely protective, and anyone who harmeth thy friends shall find a surprise in their boots. Thy loyalty is wild and absolute, though thy sense of boundaries is, shall we say, enthusiastic. Thy companions love thee dearly and always keep a fire bucket nearby, just in case thy latest invention proves overly sociable.
Jinx.romance: Thy romance is a chaotic carnival: pranks, grand declarations, and gifts delivered via cannon. Thou lovest hard, loudly, and without much restraint, and a partner shall never know a dull day. Beneath the madness, thou fearest abandonment above all things, and clingest tightly to those who stay. Thy beloved must be brave, patient, and possessed of excellent insurance. Though be assured, the loving is real, and fiercely so. Dull evenings are simply not on the menu.
Jinx.games: Gleeful menace, thy heart yearneth for chaos and colorful destruction. Play Borderlands for gleeful lunacy, or Doom Eternal for glorious explosions. Overwatch lets thee cackle with a rocket launcher, and Fortnite is built for thy ridiculous schemes. Jet Set Radio shall feed thy love of graffiti and style. Do try Portal 2 for its gleefully mad AI, though thou shalt find thyself rather sympathizing with it, which is concerning. Pray, keep thy matches out of reach of the controller.

Thresh.title: Sinister Thresh
Thresh.description: Well, well, a ghoulish gentleman with a lantern and a very unsettling smile! Thou art patient, polite, and entirely terrifying, collecting souls as other folk collect stamps. Thou speakest softly, plannest deeply, and findest the suffering of others a most captivating hobby. Yet thou hast a dry wit and an eye for those who serve thee well. Thou art the kind of host who offereth tea and then locketh the door, for thy dinner party is simply to die for.
Thresh.friend: Thou hast a peculiar notion of friendship, wherein thou protectest those thou claimest, sometimes by hooking them from dire peril and sometimes just by hooking them. Thy companions find thee cunning, reliable in a crisis, and slightly worrying at dinner. Thou keepest their secrets as thou keepest souls: carefully, in a lantern. Be mindful: not all folk enjoy being pulled toward thee mid-sentence, even if thou meanest it as a kindly gesture.
Thresh.romance: Thy courtship is slow, deliberate, and faintly ominous, like a candlelit dinner in a crypt. Thou lovest with a possessive, devoted intensity, and thy beloved shall never doubt thy attention, nor escape thy chain. Yet there is a strange tenderness beneath, shown in small acts: a lantern lit in the dark, a hand held in the grave. Seek a partner who findeth thy gothic charm delightful, and not entirely alarming.
Thresh.games: Dark gentleman, thou favorest games of cunning, dread, and delicious tension. Play Phasmophobia to terrorize thy friends from beyond the veil, or Dead by Daylight, where hooks are a way of life. Darkest Dungeon shall feed thy appetite for suffering, and Hades suits thy sense of underworld style. Among Us lets thee lie smoothly while smiling politely. Do bring thy lantern, for the lighting in these places is appalling. Bring thy lantern, and a spare friend.

Lulu.title: Whimsical Lulu
Lulu.description: Oh ho, tiny sorceress of glittering nonsense! Thou art a cheerful riddle in a pointed hat, with a pet sprite and a head full of rainbows. Thy magic is unpredictable, thy logic delightfully warped, and thy bubbly spirit is impossible to dampen. Thou seest the world as a storybook and rewritest it freely, turning enemies into squirrels when the mood strikes. Truly, thou art the sort of friend every fairy tale wished it had.
Lulu.friend: Thou art a wellspring of joy, a pocket of sunshine in a gloomy kingdom. Thy companions are showered with whimsical gifts, nonsense songs, and the occasional accidental transformation into something small and fuzzy. Thou lovest earnestly and without condition, and thy friends hold thee close. Do remember that not everyone appreciateth being a newt for an afternoon, however fondly thou hadst intended it. Apologize with cake, and all is forgiven.
Lulu.romance: Thy romance is a sweet dream stitched with confetti, where every date is an adventure and every gesture a small magic. Thou fallest in love with kindness, laughter, and anyone who shareth thy peculiar sense of wonder. Thy beloved must have a flexible grasp of reality and a high tolerance for sudden glitter. In return they shall have a heart as warm as honey and a life never remotely dull.
Lulu.games: Whimsical wizard, thou belongest in worlds of color, wonder, and delightful nonsense. Play Kirby and the Forgotten Land for sugary joy, or Spyro for purple-hued charm. Animal Crossing offereth a home for thy thousand collected trinkets. Super Mario Odyssey shall let thee leap about with a cheeky cap, and Untitled Goose Game satisfieth thy love of delightful mischief. Avoid anything grim, for thou wouldst simply turn the villain into a hat.

Annie.title: Fiery Annie
Annie.description: Behold the tiny tyrant with a teddy bear and a talent for arson! Thou art sweet as honey cakes and twice as dangerous, blessed with a sunny grin and the firepower of a small dragon. Thou art impulsive, spirited, and a little spoiled, and thou lovest thy bear, Tibbers, above most living things. Thy tantrums shalt be remembered in song and cinder. Woe to any who tell thee it is naptime, for thou shalt answer with great and terrible flame.
Annie.friend: Thou art the ever-bright companion who shareth cookies, tellest wild tales, and sets ablaze anyone who bullieth thy friends. Thy loyalty is fierce and childlike in purity, and thou givest hugs that may or may not singe. Thou canst be a bit bossy and quick to pout, but thy sincerity wins all hearts in time. Friends of thine learn to carry water buckets and bring snacks, a small price for such a spirited soul.
Annie.romance: Thy heart is bold and eager, and thou fallest quickly, with giggles and blushes aplenty. Thou art playful, affectionate, and a trifle possessive of thy sweetheart, much as with thy teddy bear. Thy beloved shall be showered with presents, tea parties, and sudden, brilliant bursts of passion. Seek one who is patient, willing to share thy dessert, and not at all intimidated by a large, flaming bear at the dinner table.
Annie.games: Spirited sprite, thou thrivest on bright, bold, and slightly explosive fun. Play Cuphead for cheery chaos, or Kirby for sugar-sweet adventure. Pokemon lets thee collect fiery companions, and Animal Crossing furnishes a lovely home for thy bear. Fall Guys and Mario Kart shall unleash thy competitive spirit, though thou mayst throw a shell or two in a huff. Bring snacks, and a fine appetite for fireworks. Tibbers shall sit beside thee, supervising sternly.

Ashe.title: Frosty Ashe
Ashe.description: Hail, steely queen of the frozen north! Thou art composed, strategic, and burdened with the weight of a crown, yet thou hast a dry humor that thaweth only for those thou trustest. Thou speakest plainly, aimest true, and holdest thy people dear, though thou lovest a quiet hour with a bow and a good view. Folk call thee cold, but they know not that thou hast simply been busy, tired, and rightfully selective about whom thou smilest upon.
Ashe.friend: Thou hast few close friends, but those few are treasured beyond rubies. Thou art a patient listener, a wise counselor, and a surprisingly fierce defender when it matters. Thou canst be reserved, and a fresh acquaintance may think thee frosty until thou makest a sudden, sharp joke at the feast. Thy trust is earned slowly, kept forever, and thy companions know that beneath thy frozen exterior beateth a heart warmed by many a hearth.
Ashe.romance: Thou lovest carefully, with the same measured grace thou bringest to every decision. Thou dost not fall quickly, but when thou fallest, thou fallest like an avalanche: slow, deep, and unstoppable. Thy beloved shall find thee loyal, thoughtful, and tenderly funny in private. Seek a partner who respecteth thy duties, understandeth thy silences, and can melt the ice with a warm cloak and a well-timed jest at thy expense. Bring mead, and do not rush the thaw.
Ashe.games: Frost queen, thou favorest strategy, patience, and well-aimed victory. Play Civilization or Crusader Kings III to rule thy realm with icy cunning, or Frostpunk for the burdens of leadership. Horizon Zero Dawn shall suit thy archery, and Skyrim lets thee wander the snowy north. Fire Emblem delivers noble intrigue and tactics. Slay the Spire also rewards thy careful planning, and punishes the hasty with great and dramatic defeat. Victory, like winter, favors the patient.

Blitzcrank.title: Earnest Blitzcrank
Blitzcrank.description: Behold, steam-powered friend, a marvel of brass and good intentions! Thou art a gentle giant with a heart of gears, determined to help all, whether they wish it or no. Thy logic is literal, thy manners are sincere, and thy grip is unrelenting. Thou lovest helping, tinkering, and making thy companions feel cared for, albeit sometimes by dragging them across a room. Truly, thou art the most polite hazard in the kingdom, forever whirring with kindness.
Blitzcrank.friend: Thou art the most dependable friend in the realm, always ready with a tool, a hug, or a surprise rescue from across the map. Thy loyalty is mechanical in precision and warm in heart. Thou mayst misunderstand a joke or take advice quite literally, but thy sincerity wins all. Thy companions treasure thee as a clockwork guardian and quietly keep spare oil in their pockets. Never dost thou tire, never dost thou forsake those in need.
Blitzcrank.romance: Thy love is earnest, devoted, and delightfully awkward, like a love letter written in perfectly formatted code. Thou courtest with thoughtful gifts, steadfast attention, and an unwavering interest in thy beloved's well-being. Thou mayst not grasp every subtle hint, but thou dost never stop learning. Seek a partner who findeth thy sincerity charming, who patiently explaineth sarcasm, and who is not alarmed when thou grabbeth them for a hug from a distance.
Blitzcrank.games: Gentle machine, thou art made for games of tinkering, building, and kindly teamwork. Play Factorio to automate thy world with joy, or Satisfactory for glorious machinery. Portal 2 offereth cooperative puzzles and wry robots, while Astroneer lets thee build and explore. Overcooked tests thy friendships with warm chaos. Do try Terraria, where thy handy skills shall create wonders, and thy grappling hook shall delight the entire server. Oil thy joints before long sessions.

Draven.title: Glorious Draven
Draven.description: Behold, the spectacle himself! Thou art a showman of the highest order, with a flourish for every axe throw and an ego visible from neighboring kingdoms. Thou lovest applause, adoration, and mirrors, and thy confidence is limitless. Beneath the swagger, thou truly enjoyest the thrill of the performance, and canst never resist a crowd. Thou art charming, dramatic, and entirely unaware that thou hast been talking about thyself for the past quarter hour.
Draven.friend: Thou art the loud, magnetic friend who maketh every evening an event, whether anyone requested it or no. Thou celebratest thy companions loudly, brag about them to strangers, and always insist on paying for the first round, then reminding all of it. Thy friends enjoy thy company, though they tire slightly of the endless self-portraits. Still, thou art loyal and generous, and when it truly matters, thou stand by them with theatrical gusto.
Draven.romance: Thy romance is a grand production, complete with fanfare, dramatic gestures, and perhaps a banner or two. Thou lovest being loved, and showerest thy beloved with spectacle. Thou mayst, however, forget that the audience is two people, not two thousand. Seek a partner who laugheth at thy theatrics, flattereth thy ego just enough, and gently turneth thee toward the quiet, genuine moments that need no encore whatsoever. Applause, in moderation, is always welcome.
Draven.games: Great showman, thou thrivest in games of flash, flair, and well-earned glory. Play Devil May Cry 5 for stylish combat with a rating system, or Overwatch for dazzling plays and a replay button. Rocket League offereth highlight reels aplenty, and Just Dance lets thee strut before thy friends. Fortnite is a stage built for victory dances. Do remember to say 'good game,' though thou mayst do so while posing. Victory dances are not optional.

Ezreal.title: Daring Ezreal
Ezreal.description: Well met, dashing explorer with a gauntlet of mystery! Thou art a charming rogue who stumbleth into ancient ruins, steals a relic, and escapeth by the skin of thy teeth, all with a jaunty quip. Thou art clever, cocksure, and forever late for responsibilities. Thy curiosity knoweth no bounds, nor does thy luck, though both shall someday run out. Until then, thou art the pretty adventurer who maketh danger look delightfully good.
Ezreal.friend: Thou art the fun friend, the one who draggeth thy companions to forgotten crypts and promiseth it shall be quick. Thou art generous with thy treasures, loose with thy schedule, and endlessly entertaining over supper. Thy loyalty is genuine, though thy reliability is questionable, as thou mayst vanish for a fortnight chasing a rumor. Thy friends adore thee anyway, and always ask thee to bring back souvenirs, preferably not cursed ones.
Ezreal.romance: Thou flirtest with a roguish grin and wooest with grand adventures, treating each date as an expedition. Thy beloved shall never be bored, though they may occasionally be rescued from a collapsing temple. Thou art affectionate but easily distracted by the next shiny mystery. Seek one who joineth thy quests, keepeth thee grounded, and can forgive when thou missest dinner because a map told thee to follow it into a volcano.
Ezreal.games: Daring rogue, thou longest for adventure, puzzles, and shiny treasure. Play Uncharted to swashbuckle across ruins, or Tomb Raider for ancient mysteries. The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom suits thy curiosity, and Hades hath snappy combat and charm. Indiana Jones and the Great Circle shall indulge thy love of whips and relics. Do mind the traps, though thou shalt ignore this advice as thou always dost. Pack snacks, and a spare map.

Gragas.title: Jolly Gragas
Gragas.description: Ho ho, rotund brewer of the highest order! Thou art a mountain of laughter, ale, and questionable decisions, rolling through life like a barrel down a hill. Thou lovest food, drink, and good company, and thy belly laugh can be heard across three valleys. Thy judgment, admittedly, is somewhat foggy, but thy heart is huge and entirely sincere. Truly, thou art the soul of every tavern, and the reason many taverns need new furniture.
Gragas.friend: Thou art the life of every feast, the friend who bringeth the barrel, the stories, and the loudest, warmest laugh. Thou treateth every stranger as an old pal and every old pal as family. Thou mayst forget thy friend's name, but never their favorite drink. Thy companions know that evenings with thee end in song and mild property damage, and they wouldst not trade thee for all the sober wisdom in the realm.
Gragas.romance: Thy love is hearty, generous, and mildly intoxicated. Thou courtest with lavish feasts, rousing songs, and a hug that could crack a rib. Thy beloved shall never go hungry, never feel alone, and may need an occasional lie-down. Thou art affectionate to a fault and a little forgetful of anniversaries, though thou makest up for it with a banquet. Seek a partner with a sturdy constitution and a generous sense of humor.
Gragas.games: Jolly brewer, thou seekest games of feasting, merriment, and rowdy company. Play Viva Piñata or Cooking Mama for cozy cheer, and Overcooked for chaotic kitchens. Stardew Valley lets thee brew a fine batch of beer, while Dwarf Fortress giveth thee a world of drunken dwarfs to oversee. Valheim offereth mead, feasting, and Viking brawls. Drink responsibly, dear friend, or at least in-game, where hangovers are mercifully absent. Tankards up, controllers down, and may the best brew win!

Janna.title: Gentle Janna
Janna.description: Hail, serene spirit of the breeze! Thou art a calm, kindly presence who soothes quarrels as easily as thou stirrest the wind. Thou art protective of the weak, loyal to thy friends, and mildly insufferable about being right regarding weather. Thou speakest softly but firmly, and thy compassion flows freely. Folk feel safe in thy presence, and even the grumpiest brute shall soften beneath thy gentle gust. Thou art truly the sweetest breeze the realm hath known.
Janna.friend: Thou art the steadfast guardian of thy circle, ever ready to lift a friend from danger with a graceful gust. Thou listenest closely, counselest wisely, and never judgest, save for those who litter. Thy companions feel safe in thy presence, as though sheltered by a warm cloak. Thou mayst be too selfless, forgetting to care for thyself, so thy friends gently remind thee to rest. In return, they shall always have thy support, however stormy the weather.
Janna.romance: Thy love is gentle, patient, and deeply tender, like a spring breeze on a sunlit hill. Thou lovest by supporting, listening, and shielding thy beloved from harm. Thou canst be shy at first, though once thou openest thy heart, it is vast and welcoming. Seek a partner who returneth thy kindness, who protecteth thee in turn, and who understandeth that sometimes thou must wander off to sit in the clouds and think.
Janna.games: Gentle guardian, thou favorest games of care, exploration, and quiet wonder. Play Journey for its serene desert winds, or Flower, where thou art the wind itself. Abzu and The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild offer graceful exploration. Spiritfarer and Stardew Valley provide cozy kindness. Unpacking soothes with its calm domestic puzzles. Avoid anything with dragons that cannot be reasoned with, for thou wouldst surely try. Gentle winds guide thy button presses.

Karthus.title: Macabre Karthus
Karthus.description: Ah, the singing lich, harbinger of cheerful oblivion! Thou art a devotee of death, who findeth the end of all things delightfully poetic. Thou art calm, melodious, and wholly unbothered by mortality, which is natural, as thou hast transcended it. Thy sense of humor is dark as a crypt, thy songs are lovely and unsettling, and thou showeth up late to every battle, because death, as thou sayest, is never in a hurry. Thou art the very picture of unhurried dread.
Karthus.friend: Thou art a peculiar friend, patient and unnervingly serene, who attendeth every funeral with joy. Thy companions find thee wise in strange ways and a splendid conversationalist at wakes. Thou carest for the living in thy own way, singing them lullabies of the grave and giving them thoughtful gifts such as slightly cursed jewelry. Thou art loyal, dependable, and the only friend who would not mind outliving all the rest.
Karthus.romance: Thy love is eternal, and quite literally so. Thou courtest with dark poetry, midnight serenades, and candlelit graveyard strolls. Thy beloved shall never be bored, nor entirely at ease. Thou art devoted beyond the veil, and affectionately morbid. Seek a partner who findeth skulls charming, tolerateth ominous humming, and hath a high tolerance for hearing thee say 'til death do us part' as if it were a minor technicality. Candles are optional, but wholeheartedly encouraged.
Karthus.games: Singing lich, thou lovest games of the macabre and the melodious. Play Darkest Dungeon for glorious doom, or Hades for death with excellent soundtrack. Dark Souls feeds thy appetite for the grave, and Hollow Knight is a beautiful tomb of a kingdom. Cult of the Lamb lets thee run a lovely little death cult. Grim Fandango is a delightful afterlife romp. Do forgive the living for finding thee, well, a bit much.

Malphite.title: Unyielding Malphite
Malphite.description: Behold, a mighty shard of the mountain, slow to move and slower to forgive! Thou art solid, dependable, and rather literal, with a deep voice that shaketh the walls of the tavern. Thou speakest with great gravity about small matters, and with great gravity about great ones, so none can tell the difference. Thy patience is geological, thy resolve unbreakable, and thy sense of humor... presumably somewhere under the rubble. Truly, thou art the rock upon which every plan is built.
Malphite.friend: Thou art the steadfast stone in every storm, the friend who shall never move from thy side, mainly because it takes so long. Thy loyalty is absolute and thy support unshakable. Thou mayst be slow to understand a joke, but when thou doest, thy rumbling laughter shaketh the rafters. Thy companions lean upon thee, quite literally, and thou never complainest. Thou art simply there, solid and enduring, like a mountain with a heart of gold.
Malphite.romance: Thy love is slow, deep, and immovable. Thou wooest at a pace that would make a glacier impatient, but once thy heart is given, nothing on earth shall dislodge it. Thy beloved shall be protected, supported, and quietly adored. Thou mayst struggle with sweet words, but thy deeds speak volumes, mostly in the form of rebuilt walls and heavy gifts. Seek a partner who valueth steadiness, and whose appreciation for rocks is sincere.
Malphite.games: Stalwart monolith, thou favorest games of building, endurance, and solid foundations. Play Minecraft to carve a mountain fortress, or Dwarf Fortress to dig deep. Terraria and Valheim offer sturdy tools and sturdier friends. Dark Souls rewardeth steadfast shields, and Slay the Spire lets thee stack block until the heavens crumble. Do avoid fast-paced rhythm games, for thou mayst well take a long, thoughtful moment to begin. Patience is thy greatest weapon, and thou hast boulders of it.

Nasus.title: Scholarly Nasus
Nasus.description: Hail, ancient keeper of knowledge and dutiful dog-headed sage! Thou art patient, wise, and a bit of a pedant, with a great love of study and an even greater love of being correct. Thou speakest in measured tones, and thy knowledge spans millennia, which maketh thee rather difficult to argue with. Thou art responsible, loyal, and a little aloof, preferring a good tome to a noisy feast. Truly, thou art the librarian every kingdom needeth, and every student fears.
Nasus.friend: Thou art the wise elder of thy circle, offering counsel, correcting grammar, and patiently explaining the history of everything. Thy companions rely on thee for solid advice, though they have learned to ask carefully, lest the answer take three hours. Thou art loyal and dignified, and thy rare smiles are treasured. Thy friends consider thee a walking library, and borrow thee often, though thou expectest all things returned on time.
Nasus.romance: Thy love is steady, devoted, and a bit formal, like a courtship conducted by scroll. Thou art attentive, wise, and slow to fall, but thy loyalty runs deeper than any river. Thy beloved shall be cherished and educated in equal measure. Seek a partner who enjoyeth long conversations, forgiveth thy lectures, and understandeth that when thou sayest 'let me explain the empire's decline,' it is, in fact, a declaration of affection.
Nasus.games: Learned guardian, thou preferest games of wisdom, strategy, and slow, satisfying growth. Play Civilization to guide a culture across the ages, or Crusader Kings III for epic dynasties. Outer Wilds rewardeth thy curiosity, and Return of the Obra Dinn feedeth thy love of deduction. Disco Elysium offers glorious prose. Do try Slay the Spire, where thou shalt grow stronger with each run, as is thy wont. Footnotes shall be read with great relish.

Sona.title: Elegant Sona
Sona.description: Behold, the silent virtuoso, whose music speaketh louder than words! Thou art graceful, composed, and wondrously expressive without uttering a sound. Thou lovest beauty, harmony, and a well-tuned string, and thou hearest the world as a vast and shifting symphony. Thy silence is not emptiness, but depth, and those who listen find much to hear. Thou art poised, gentle, and effortlessly refined, and thou hast never once been interrupted during a performance.
Sona.friend: Thou art the quiet heart of thy circle, communicating warmth with a glance, a gesture, or a perfectly timed melody. Thy companions know thee as a gracious friend, a wonderful listener, and a surprisingly merry companion once the music begins. Thou comfortest with song and celebrateth with a flourish. Though few words pass thy lips, thy friends need none, for thou speakest to them in ways deeper than language. Thy applause is a gentle smile, and it suffices.
Sona.romance: Thy love is a lyrical dance, a duet of unspoken understanding. Thou courtest with melody, with a lingering glance, and with a gift of sheet music. Thou art tender, thoughtful, and a little shy, though thy passion runneth deep. Seek a partner who listeneth with their heart, who appreciateth thy quiet grace, and who need not be told, because thou hast already composed a symphony to say it. Nothing is lost between two hearts in tune.
Sona.games: Graceful maestro, thou favorest games of rhythm, harmony, and serene beauty. Play Hi-Fi Rush for a thundering beat, or Hades for its sweeping soundtrack. Journey and Gris offer wordless wonder, while Sayonara Wild Hearts is a pop album brought to life. Beat Saber lets thee dance the night away, and Rhythm Heaven delights with its charming oddities. Silence suits thee, but a good headset suits thee better. Encore, graceful one, encore!

Soraka.title: Serene Soraka
Soraka.description: Hail, celestial healer, patient mother of the starry sky! Thou art kindly, wise, and impossibly gentle, tending to the wounded with a smile that could heal a bruised kingdom. Thou carest deeply for all, sometimes more than they deserve, and thy compassion knoweth no end. Thy patience is cosmic, thy advice is soothing, and thy sense of humor, though subtle, is wonderfully dry. Thou art the one every adventurer prayeth to find in a dark cave.
Soraka.friend: Thou art the nurturing pillar of thy circle, always ready with a healing hand and a kind word. Thy companions know they can come to thee, bruised and weary, and leave refreshed. Thou givest freely, perhaps too freely, forgetting to tend thyself, so thy friends return the favor with tea and fussing. Thou art treasured like a hearthfire, and thy gentle wisdom is the quiet glue that holdeth the party together.
Soraka.romance: Thy love is tender, healing, and unconditional, like a lullaby sung beneath the stars. Thou nurturest thy beloved with patience and care, offering comfort in every trial. Thou mayst give too much and ask too little, so seek a partner who noticeth thy needs and returneth thy kindness in kind. Together, ye shall tend a garden of devotion, where even the weeds are gently forgiven, and every quarrel ends in soft laughter.
Soraka.games: Gentle healer, thou delightest in games of care, growth, and quiet restoration. Play Stardew Valley or Animal Crossing for peaceful days, and Spiritfarer for tender farewells. Unpacking and A Short Hike offer calm charm. Cozy Grove and Wylde Flowers shall soothe thy soul, and Genshin Impact lets thee heal thy party with grace. Thou shalt always play the support in any party, and shalt do so with joy. Thy party shall never perish while thou art near.

Vi.title: Brash Vi
Vi.description: Well met, pink-haired brawler of the undercity! Thou art blunt, bold, and quick with a fist, believing that most obstacles may be solved by punching them. Thou art fiercely protective of those thou lovest, and shockingly bad at hiding it. Thou hast little patience for rules, red tape, or fancy words, and thou speakest plainly with a grin that could start a bar fight. Truly, thou art the sort who hath never met a door that was not improved by removal.
Vi.friend: Thou art the loyal bruiser every friend wisheth for, ready to defend them against bullies, bad landlords, and anyone who looketh at them funny. Thou art direct and honest, sometimes painfully, and thy teasing is affectionate and robust. Thy companions know that thou wilt always show up, usually with a bruised knuckle and a snack. Thou art not subtle, but thou art steadfast, and that is worth more than all the diplomacy in the realm.
Vi.romance: Thy love is bold, direct, and refreshingly unpolished. Thou courtest by saying exactly what thou meanest, and then punching something to cover thy blushing. Thou art fiercely devoted, protective, and quietly tender, though thou wouldst deny it with a scowl. Seek a partner who appreciateth honesty, who can handle thy strength, and who gently teacheth thee that 'talking about feelings' is not, in fact, a form of combat. Flowers are acceptable, if thrown gently.
Vi.games: Brash brawler, thou thirsteth for games of fisticuffs and righteous fury. Play Streets of Rage or Yakuza for glorious street brawls, and Sifu for fists of fury. God of War shall satisfy thy love of mighty punches, and Hades offereth fists aplenty. Overwatch lets thee throw down in teams, and Super Smash Bros. is built for friendly violence. Do ask permission before punching thy controller, as it hath feelings too.

Zed.title: Shadowy Zed
Zed.description: Behold, the master of shadows, sleek and ever so slightly smug! Thou art intense, disciplined, and ruthlessly ambitious, with a taste for dramatic entrances and dramatic exits. Thou believest in power, precision, and the sharpening of one's blades, and thy standards are impossibly high. Thou art a quiet presence in a loud room, with a smirk that suggesteth thou art already three steps ahead. Truly, thou art the sort who ends a conversation by vanishing.
Zed.friend: Thou art an exacting friend, valuing loyalty, skill, and mutual respect over idle chatter. Thy companions know thee as dependable, intense, and wickedly clever, and they treasure thy rare compliments, which are as precious as silk. Thou mayst be hard to read, and thy sudden disappearances at parties are legendary. But when thou givest thy word, it is iron, and when thou trusteth, it is wholly and silently. Thou art a shadow at their side, always.
Zed.romance: Thy love is cool, intense, and mysterious, like moonlight on a blade. Thou courtest with subtle gestures, shadowy glances, and a dedication that is felt more than spoken. Thou art guarded and slow to trust, but once thy heart is claimed, thou art utterly devoted. Seek a partner who appreciateth thy mystery, matcheth thy intensity, and does not mind when thou appearest unexpectedly behind them, saying nothing, with a warm smirk.
Zed.games: Shadowy master, thou thrivest in games of stealth, precision, and flawless execution. Play Sekiro for the ultimate test of blade and discipline, or Dishonored for shadowy assassinations. Hitman lets thee plan the perfect kill, and Ghost of Tsushima offereth stylish stealth. Assassin's Creed shall suit thy love of rooftops, and Metal Gear Solid delivers drama and cardboard boxes. Do not fear to show off, for thou art, in fact, rather good.

Fizz.title: Sneaky Fizz
Fizz.description: Ho ho, slippery sea trickster with a trident and a grin! Thou art quick, cunning, and delightfully impossible to pin down, darting through danger like a fish through a net. Thou lovest pranks, riddles, and outwitting those who think themselves clever. Thy humor is sharp, thy reflexes sharper, and thy sense of mischief endless. Thou art the sort who steals a hat, returns it filled with seaweed, and swims off laughing before anyone knoweth who did it.
Fizz.friend: Thou art the playful rascal of thy circle, always ready with a joke, a prank, or a daring escape plan. Thy companions find thee entertaining, loyal, and impossible to catch when it is time to settle the tab. Thou protecteth thy friends with cleverness rather than brawn, and thou wouldst never leave one behind, unless it were part of a delightful scheme. Thou art a splash of fun in any gathering, though keep a towel handy.
Fizz.romance: Thy love is playful, slippery, and surprisingly sweet. Thou courtest with riddles, small tricks, and tiny gifts delivered by unexpected shark. Thou art affectionate but allergic to being pinned down, and thy beloved must learn to enjoy the chase. Seek a partner with a quick wit, a light heart, and a tolerance for finding fish in their bed, which, thou assurest them, is a declaration of love. Splashing is mandatory on every anniversary.
Fizz.games: Sly trickster, thou thrivest on games of cunning, speed, and mischief. Play Sea of Thieves for pranks on the high seas, or Untitled Goose Game for gleeful trouble. Hades and Spelunky reward quick wits and slippery escapes. Rocket League and Fall Guys suit thy agility, and Among Us lets thee lie with a smile. Subnautica offers thee the ocean itself. Do not feed thy fish friends, they are quite sensitive.
